wacm_billing.py (4 tools: invoice list/get, usage list/get)

HTTP 429: retry once after Retry-After (default 5 s), then report
Tests for all five modules with respx against FAKE['wacm'] using rest_settings/rest_server

scope_items.item: Docs for the five modules under docs/tools/
AC: wacm_sub_account_create with a 10 TB hard quota sends the documented JSON body to wacm_url with Basic auth (S6)
AC: wacm_sub_account_list and wacm_usage_list together give per-sub-account usage-vs-quota data for S7 (respx test)
AC: when has_wacm is false, every WACM tool returns a ToolRefused naming the missing variables
AC: a WACM JSON error {error, code} comes back as HTTP <status>: <error>
AC: WACM write tools refuse in read-only mode, and delete tools refuse without confirm=true
Any secret WACM returns on creation is returned only on confirmation

edge_cases.description: Second consecutive HTTP 429 is reported rather than retried again
Page envelope variants: last page, totalPages only, no counts (full-page heuristic), bare list
Key/secret/password fields scrubbed at any depth from all responses except the create result's dedicated key fields
Sub-account create validates name length, password-or-welcome-email, and Hard quota needing purchased_storage_tb before any network call
Update tools refuse an empty change set
wacm_channel_user_update has no empty-body guard and would PUT {} when no fields are given (inconsistent with the other update tools; not harmful)
